notes_for_editor: Identity unconfirmed. The name and tower tag come from OpenStreetMap, whose node carries GNIS tags from an import. Nothing read says it was a fire lookout or was run by the Florida Forest Service. TopoZone's nearby list includes a Bell Fire Tower; the Forest Lookouts Bell page (record bell2, 29.8037, -82.8677) is about 19 km north, so it is a different structure. Record coordinates match OSM; TopoZone's point is about 30 m away. No history source was found within the search and read budget. A human should confirm this is a fire lookout before the story is published.
